summary: Iter 12 — Partner 3-step onboarding + partner campaigns list + admin launch-check with 'connect' item + rrclub.online rebrand verified end-to-end. Backend 5/5 passing (test_iter12_partner_onboarding.py): GET /api/dashboard/partner returns campaigns[] with CLUB-10 (cupom/influencer/status); GET /api/admin/launch-check returns 12 items incl id 'connect' and 403 for partner; POST /api/partner/connect/onboard returns available:false with reason string; GET /api/campaigns/{id}/poster.pdf is a valid PDF and does NOT contain literal 'theclub.pt'. Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080): partner login shows data-testid=partner-onboarding, partner-onboarding-progress='2/3', onboarding-step-iban-done & onboarding-step-campaign-done present, onboarding-step-iban-cta absent (IBAN exists — not modified); clicking onboarding-step-connect-cta ('Ativar') shows toast about Stripe Connect not active, step becomes 'Indisponível por agora' and CTA becomes disabled. partner-campaigns-card lists partner-campaign-row-<id> with CLUB-10; partner-campaign-qr-<id> opens coupon-qr-dialog; coupon-qr-poster downloads exactly 'cartaz-CLUB-10.pdf'; coupon-qr-download downloads exactly 'cupao-CLUB-10.png'. Admin /admin/definicoes shows launch-checklist-card labeled 'Checklist pós-Publish (rrclub.online)' with score '7/12 prontos' and launch-item-connect present.

minor.issue: launch-item 'connect' returns ok=true ('Connect ativo') because heuristic in routes_ops.py:249-254 just calls stripe.Account.list(limit=1) which succeeds even when Connect is NOT enabled for creating express accounts. Meanwhile POST /api/partner/connect/onboard correctly returns available:false. The two signals disagree; reviewer expected launch-item-connect to be red. Suggest tightening the heuristic to actually attempt Account.create(type='express') in a try/rollback OR probe a Connect-only endpoint (e.g. stripe.Account.create dry-run / capability check) so admin sees red until Connect is truly usable.

action_items: Fix launch-check 'connect' heuristic so it returns ok=false when platform Stripe cannot actually onboard Connect accounts (currently green while partner onboarding returns available:false — misleading for admin). See routes_ops.py:248-254.

rca of the issue: launch-check connect heuristic uses stripe.Account.list() which merely lists connected accounts (returns empty on a non-Connect account without erroring on many stripe-python versions), while the real Connect-availability signal comes from Account.create(type='express') which is what connect_onboard uses. Fix: probe with the same call path (or a capability lookup on the platform account) so admin dashboard mirrors partner UX.
